unassigned_issues.title: Models list for the Bedrock SDK
include ping and error in RawMessageStreamEvent
Undefined vs null fields from the OpenAPI specs
docs: Broken compare links in CHANGELOG.md files
json_schema structured output truncates content at HTML tags containing quotation marks
Bug: `toolRunner`'s `setMessagesParams` causes duplicate tool call loops
partialParse in _vendor/partial-json-parser crashes on invalid JSON escape sequences from model output
[Vertex] anthropic-beta header forwarded to countTokens fallback fails on lagging model backends
Adopt `TracingChannel` for observability
`always_allow` permission policy not honored for `agent.custom_tool_use` MCP tool calls (Managed Agents beta)
idempotencyKey is a silent no-op: base Anthropic client never sets idempotencyHeader
`transformJSONSchema` drops `const`/`enum` into description text, breaking discriminated unions in tool inputs
Citations: raw `<cite index="N-M">` markup leaks into text blocks instead of being parsed into `citations` (search_result blocks)
Managed Agents egress gateway omits SNI on upstream TLS to Cloudflare R2 (503 HANDSHAKE_FAILURE_ON_CLIENT_HELLO)
helpers.md: tool runner method heading is missing the .beta segment
BetaMessageStream: compaction_delta coerces a null content into the literal string "null", and a null encrypted_content erases the established checkpoint
Retrying a request with a single-use stream body silently sends a 0-byte body and reports success
BetaLocalFilesystemMemoryTool: rename of the /memories root is not rejected, and unmapped filesystem errors (EINVAL, ENOTDIR) expose the host path to the model
Memory tool: two edits to one file in the same turn silently lose one (BetaToolRunner runs tool calls concurrently; BetaLocalFilesystemMemoryTool has no serialization)
BetaLocalFilesystemMemoryTool.str_replace: a multi-line old_str never matches, and an omitted new_str writes the word "undefined"
jsonSchemaOutputFormat drops constraints for array-form types (nullable objects)
`EnvironmentWorker` cannot be created with the `Client` class from `@anthropic-ai/aws-sdk`
Replayed preview starts overwrite completed managed-agent messages
Late preview deltas modify authoritative managed-agent messages
Synchronous token-provider failures bypass advisory recovery and refresh deduplication
SessionToolRunner repeats completed tool side effects after result delivery fails
Schema transformation discards sibling type and composition constraints
MessageStream.emitted promises remain pending after the stream is aborted
Fallback state is pinned to models that refuse or fail before serving a response
Streaming fallback middleware retains abort listeners after completion and cancellation
MessageStream async iteration silently completes when an error occurs between reads
setMessagesParams lets the tool runner append turns into caller-owned history arrays
Malformed OAuth token responses can escape validation or throw TypeError
